collection.description: Everyone keeps asking a teen what they want to be, and the teen does not know.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Everyone keeps asking (subject) what (subject.he/she) wants to be. A builder? A healer? A farmer? A scholar? (subject) doesn't know. (subject.He/She) likes lots of things. (subject.He/She) also likes lying on the beach. Today (friend) asks again, kindly, and (subject) just shrugs, and then, unexpectedly, feels a bit miserable about it.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: "I don't know," says (subject). "Everyone else seems to know." (friend) laughs. "I didn't know until I was much older than you. Some people never decide. They just do lots of things." (subject) looks at (friend.him/her) suspiciously. "Is that allowed?" "It's allowed." (subject) feels a bit better. Not completely. A bit.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: "A professional cloud watcher," says (subject). (friend) doesn't even blink. "Good choice. Long hours, though." (subject) laughs in spite of (subject.him/her)self. They spend the afternoon inventing jobs: shell counter, tide minder, official tester of mangoes. None of them are real. It's still the best talk about the future (subject) has had all year.
